completion_promises.criterion_text: Another student's fetch of an announced chunk is refused as forbidden; a fetch of the same chunk through the owner's *other* session is refused as not found (session-scoped references)
completion_promises.evidence: Added session ownership verification to voice_audio handler in src/study_tutor/voice/routes.py. Both ownership tests now pass: test_another_student_cannot_fetch_announced_chunks returns 403 Forbidden, test_chunk_fetch_from_other_session_is_not_found returns 404 Not Found due to session-scoped ChunkStore keys.
